additional_info.subject: Notes
additional_info.body: Analyzed the NWYmy6 charger and didn't find any issues related to a general error. Assigning this case to Francois as discussed in the NOC standup.

additional_info.subject: Analyse 1
additional_info.body:
After reviewing with RC-FR we aggred that we will analyses those 5 chargers with the latest HF (installed last week):
M8i3IC, 5yTtVX, and UmmAc4 (HF apllied the 12/05/2025).
The focus of the analyse will be on the Gerneral error (keyword : SIXml)
There is not Error genaral since the HF has been applied.

additional_info.subject: Analyse
additional_info.body: Analysis done by Francois and Jessica to see if the issue is persistent or not, after mass analysis with the new FW. We see a low failure rate of transactions on the Valina. Some issues remain but are due to the customer or the Worldline backend/Bank. The ticket can be closed. I will join the document to the ticket.
